title: Is your routine working?
caption: how do you actually know if your routine works? #skincare #skincareroutine #glowup

slides.text: Why you can't tell if your routine is *actually working*

slides.title: You see your face *every day*
slides.body: Slow changes are invisible when you compare yourself to yesterday.

slides.title: Lighting *lies*
slides.body: Bathroom light vs daylight can make the same skin look completely different.

slides.title: You change *too much* at once
slides.body: New cleanser + new serum + new moisturizer = no idea what helped.

slides.title: What works
items: Compare week 1 vs week 6, not today vs yesterday

slides.title: I built *Glowtrack* to do this tracking for me.
